g.text: The complex issue of social media's impact on users' well-being involves a wide
array of stakeholders. At the heart of this ecosystem are the users, whose mental
health both inﬂuences and is inﬂuenced by their interactions on social media, and
the social media companies, which play a signiﬁcant role in shaping these
interactions through platform design, algorithms, and revenue-driven business
Surrounding these core actors are a diverse group of tertiary stakeholders who
indirectly affect users' well-being. These parties can either foster a supportive
environment that promotes mental health or exacerbate challenges, as mental
health organizations and educators may encourage healthier online habits, while
advertisers and content creators often prioritize engagement and proﬁt, often
The interactions and tensions between these stakeholders ultimately shape the
overall impact of social media on well-being, emphasizing the need for
collaborative efforts to mitigate harm and enhance positive outcomes.
A network of stakeholder relationships and inﬂuences
